children: Bimini Capital appointed Richard H. Parry as a Class II director, with his term expiring at the 2029 annual meeting of stockholders.
Class II director; President and Chief Investment Officer of Tom Johnson Investment Management, LLC

President & CIO of TJIM since 2003; investment career began 1981; B.S. Business (Univ. of Colorado); MBA (Oklahoma City University); CFA charterholder; former adjunct professor and past president of Oklahoma Society of Financial Analysts; serves on board of Oklahoma Medical Research Foundation.
Not expected to serve on a committee at this time
